title: Meltemi Diagrams project
description: project.json marks the root of a Meltemi Diagrams project. See docs/language/projects.md.

name.description: Project name, shown in catalogs and reports.

language.description: Language version used by every .meltemi file of the project.

tools.description: Version ranges of the tools that may build the project.

meltemi-diagrams.description: Exact version, ^x.y.z, ~x.y.z, comparators such as ">=0.3.0 <1.0.0", or *.

sources.description: Folders or files, relative to project.json, whose .meltemi files are compiled.

exclude.description: Paths, relative to project.json, that are never compiled. node_modules and hidden folders are always excluded.

format.description: Formatter settings used by meltemi-diagrams format and editors.

theme.description: Default theme of diagrams without a theme property: a built-in theme, or "<path>#<theme id>" relative to project.json.

locale.description: The language of the words the tool adds to exported drawings, HTML players and catalogs: English or Spanish.

icons.description: Icon pack aliases: "cloud": "aws" lets diagrams write cloud:lambda for aws:lambda.

catalog.description: What meltemi-diagrams build catalog writes and leaves out. See docs/catalog.md.

title.description: Title of the catalog; the project name by default.

description.description: Text shown on the catalog's home page.

out.description: Folder (which receives index.html) or .html file inside the project, relative to project.json.

exclude.description: Folders or files left out of the catalog, or "<file>.meltemi#<id>" for one diagram or story.

source.description: Include the text of each catalogued file, comments included.

plugins.description: Plugins installed explicitly: their folders inside the project, exact versions and the permissions granted. Plugins are data; their code is never run. See docs/plugins.md.

path.description: The plugin's folder, relative to project.json, holding meltemi-plugin.json.

permissions.description: What the project lets the plugin contribute.

cloud.description: The cloud project this folder mirrors: the service's address and the project's id. meltemi-diagrams push --create and pull write it; push, pull, publish and review --base cloud read it. See docs/cli.md.

host.description: The service's origin, such as "https://diagrams.meltemi.dev"; http: only for 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1]. It never chooses where a token goes: a command whose host differs from this one fails.

project.description: The cloud project's id: 20 lower-case letters and digits.
